The 'Red Flags' section also warns against 'Add multiple changes, run tests'.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt requires documenting what was found and why the fix works

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt requires verifying the fix actually resolves the reported issue
criteriaResults.reasoning: Phase 3, Step 3 ('Verify Before Continuing') and Phase 4, Step 3 ('Verify Fix') both require explicit verification that the fix worked and didn't break other things.
